name: Higashimiyoshi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Higashimiyoshi town emblem in green, blue and orange: a green and orange ring enclosing blue stylised stepping stones.
history: Municipal flag of Higashimiyoshi, a town in Tokushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 March 2006.

features.role: Higashimiyoshi town emblem — a green and orange ring enclosing blue stylised stepping stones
